==Walkthrough== {{Map|zoom=1|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=Key locations:
'''Red:''' Guild Hunter Fox and smooth leaves.
'''Yellow:''' Sticky leaves and embertailed jerboas.
'''Green:''' Atza |1618,2979,icon:redPin,desc:Guild Hunter Fox/smooth leaves |1673,2992,icon:yellowPin,desc:Sticky leaves and jerboas |1697,3064,icon:greenPin,desc:Atza}} {{Checklist| * Speak to [[Guildmaster Apatura]] in the [[Hunters' Guild]]. {{Chat option|2Can I help you with anything?}} * Go down the stairs in the big tree in the middle of Hunters' Guild. * Speak to [[Guild Scribe Verity]] behind the bar. * Talk to [[Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)]] just west of the bar to get a [[toy mouse]]. * Wind up the toy mouse and then use it on [[Guild Hunter Kiko]] to distract him. * Check Kiko's [[Cat bed (At First Light)|cat bed]]. * Return to Wolf and talk to her again. * Buy a box trap from [[Imia's Supplies]] if you do not have one. Pick up the needle spawn in the fur shop for later use. * Go back up the stairs and head south-east from the guild towards the mine to find [[Guild Hunter Fox]] laying down. He can be found south-east of the mining symbol (south-west of Fairy Ring {{fairycode|AJP}}) * Talk to Fox. * Take a leaf from the [[leafy bush]]. The bush is south-west of him and browner than the other bushes. * Go east to the [[Locus Oasis]] and pick from the [[rough-looking bush]] for a second leaf. The bush is south of the hunter symbol on the map, on the west coast of the oasis. * While here, catch two [[Embertailed jerboa]] using a box trap for their tails. * Use the [[Jerboa tail]] on the leaves to create [[Makeshift poultice]]. * Return to Fox and talk to him again. * Head to [[Atza]], who is in one of the buildings just east of the southern gate of [[Civitas illa Fortis]] (west of the pub). Talk to her. * Set-up the [[pile of equipment]] in the middle of the room. (A hammer is available in the house to the north.) * Talk to Atza to get the [[trimmed fur]]. * Return to Fox. He will give you [[Fox's report|a report]] for the guild. * Return to Guild Scribe Verity, down the stairs in the [[Hunter Guild]], and give her the report. * Use the remaining jerboa tail on the cat bed to fix it. * Head back upstairs, and talk to Guildmaster Apatura. * '''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
